title: The Biscuit Crate
introNarration: Nett draws the shape of the crate in the mud with one finger, including the mark on the lid. "College mark, burnt into the end board. I carried it out of your own store and down the bank myself, so I know the one." He rubs the drawing out. "South then east, the cargo hollow. Examine the biscuit crate and you will see I am not lying about the mark. There is a deck-hand on the skiff-line who will not let you past. Then talk nett. I carried that tin once. I am not carrying it again."
reminderNarration: "Examine the biscuit crate in the cargo hollow. Defeat the deck-hand on the skiff-line. Then talk nett. Type south from Willow Bend."
completionNarration: Nett takes the dented tin, turns it until the College mark is facing up, and hands it straight back to you. "There. Now it is yours and not theirs, and I have carried it the right direction once." He sits back down on the root. "Midge is west and then south, on the heron post. She hung a whistle up so the landing would hear a rope go. The camp took it off the nail the same week they took your crate. Talk midge. I am going to sit here until Marram trusts me with a knot again."

objectives.label: Examine the Biscuit Crate in the Cargo Hollow. Type south from the skiff-line.
